_note: 'id' is required in practice: it is the account's stable identity key. It keys the
SQLite history (snapshots.account_id), the /api/quota payload, the Homepage widget
map (items['<id>_<window>']) and the error list — so it MUST be unique per account
and MUST NOT change once the panel is running (changing it starts a new history
series and renames the Homepage widgets). Lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
If 'id' is omitted it falls back to a positional '<provider>-<index>', so inserting
or reordering accounts silently reassigns ids and can swap history between them.
Duplicate ids are fatal: the app refuses to start with
'account ids must be unique: [...]'. 'label' is free text and purely cosmetic.
Credentials: exactly one of 'token' (the key itself), 'token_env' (the NAME of an
environment variable holding it) or 'token_file' (path to a file holding it).
_retention_note: History is written on every poll, so raw samples are kept for raw_days and then
pruned; before a raw row is dropped, its rollup_seconds-wide bucket is aggregated
into 'rollups' (count / sum / min / max, so rolling a rollup up again stays exact)
and kept for rollup_days. Raw is only ever deleted once its bucket is covered.
The block above is the default: remove it and the same values apply.
